title: (LEAD) Seoul stocks slide over 3 pct on profit-taking amid persistent AI woes
caption:
South Korea's benchmark KOSPI tumbled over 3.5 percent as institutional investors dumped major chipmakers. Despite solid earnings from US tech leaders, markets remain uneasy about the sheer cost of building AI infrastructure.
